name: r012.live_avatar_visible_bootstrap_mcw
description: Zero-gameplay-credit live bootstrap for a later independent R-012 observation proof.  It binds one native avatar-visible terrain target while an explicitly staged zombie dog remains twelve map squares south, outside the native 3x3 observation payload.  A later worker may move the avatar south and call game.look on the pre-move opaque handle; this bootstrap does not perform that stale-handle validation.

steps.label: post_load_r012_bootstrap_hud
steps.abort_reason: the source-bound R-012 fixture did not reach ordinary gameplay

steps.label: bind_native_avatar_visible_observation
steps.movement_route: Later independent validation: retain one opaque handle from this game.observe result, make one ordinary south movement, then call game.look on the old handle and require stale_visible_handle.  The dog starts at offset_ms=[0,12,0], outside the native 3x3 payload; no dog observation or gameplay behavior is asserted here.
steps.expected_visible_fact: one avatar-visible native terrain target is bound through game.observe without exposing the offscreen zombie dog

evidence_contract.claim: only source/setup binding and the live native game.observe boundary are prepared; this scenario grants zero gameplay credit
evidence_contract.failure_rule: a missing native frame, empty avatar-visible payload, incompatible source fixture, missing required stabilizer, or failed cleanup leaves the later R-012 proof unproved; do not infer stale-handle behavior from this bootstrap
